AssessmentDetail.description:
Summary plus the full engine payload.

`result` is intentionally untyped here. It is the engine's own contract and
mirroring its 200-odd fields in Pydantic would create a second definition
that drifts. The engine's shape is pinned by the engine tests and published
in packages/contracts/openapi.json.
AssessmentDetail.title: AssessmentDetail

ComplianceCaseCreate.description:
Creating a case by hand.

Normally the evaluator writes these. A compliance officer can also open one
from a review, which is why the route exists — but it still demands the rule
and the pack version it rests on.
ComplianceCaseCreate.title: ComplianceCaseCreate

ConfirmIntakeRequest.description: Confirmed values, written to the profile and activity records.
ConfirmIntakeRequest.title: ConfirmIntakeRequest

FactorySummary.description: Factory plus its latest headline, for list screens.
FactorySummary.title: FactorySummary

InviteResult.description:
What comes back from an invite.

`temporary_password` is present only when the invite created a brand-new
account, and it is the one and only time the platform will show it. There is
no email delivery in this build, so the inviter has to pass it on out of
band; pretending otherwise would leave people with accounts they cannot
reach.
InviteResult.title: InviteResult

PlantProfileIn.description: Exactly what `engine.assess()` consumes. Field names are engine-defined.
PlantProfileIn.title: PlantProfileIn

ReadinessItem.description:
One line of the readiness view.

`status` is a readiness state, never a legal determination. `basis` says
where it came from so the UI never has to guess whether a line is engine
output, an evidence check or a stored case.
ReadinessItem.title: ReadinessItem

ScenarioModification.description:
One declarative change applied to a baseline profile. PRD FR-34.

Deliberately a small closed set. A free-form patch would let the client
write any number into the engine input, which is exactly the door PRD
section 3.1 closes.
ScenarioModification.title: ScenarioModification
